mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO mcp_business_operation (id, request_id, tool_name, request_hash, created_project, status, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestId}, #{toolName}, #{requestHash}, 0, 'RUNNING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mcp_business_operation WHERE request_id = #{key} FOR UPDATE
